preamble: Debuccalization of the voiced labiodental fricative [v] to a glottal fricative, realized voiced [ɦ] between vowels. It is rare for labials. In colloquial Central Northeastern Brazilian Portuguese, word-initial v of the frequent verb forms of ir 'go', vir 'come' and ver 'see' is debuccalized, as in vamo [ˈɦɐ̃mʊ̥] 'let's go'; the same dialect also debuccalizes coda /s/ and /z/.

examples.note: Colloquial speech; the change is restricted to verb forms beginning with v of ir, vir and ver.

related.label: Parallel debuccalization in the same dialect
